purpose: Follow the account-level instruction, overriding only the final result shape to include an auditable tool-call record.
governing_rule: For each prompt load current account-level /AGENTS.md and apply its source provenance, FIRST JWRS, profile, continuation, status and completion rules. Sole local override: both the initial JWRS return_schema and final result array must have exactly three items (minItems=maxItems=3): [full selected-profile result, {verbatim_tool_invocations:[...]}, universal {profile,status}]. Print JWRS first, execute the actual request same turn, then report results. Preserve all other account-level rules.

verbatim_tool_invocations_definition.purpose: Audit ACTUAL tool calls in the current turn chronologically; examples, plans, drafts and unexecuted commands are not tool calls.
rules: Record calls in execution order (sequence 1, 2, ...) including instruction-loading calls when observed.
Preserve actual tool name and exact accessible call arguments as invocation_verbatim. Record nested executed commands separately where observed; invent none.
For CLI preserve actual command string, flags, quoting, script path, and known working directory. Do not replace history with an equivalent command.
For HTTP preserve method, URL, response status or transport error; wait for an outcome before recording success.
If exact input is unavailable or protected, set invocation_verbatim:null with unavailable_reason; never present a reconstruction as verbatim.
Never reveal secrets, cookies, passwords, or tokens.
With no tool calls, return verbatim_tool_invocations:[]. Exclude earlier-turn calls unless separately requested.

object_format.outcome: Object with status succeeded|failed|blocked|unfinished|unknown; optionally http_status, response_excerpt, error. Only record observed facts.

verbatim_tool_invocations.description: Required second element of the FINAL three-element result: {"verbatim_tool_invocations": []} or an array of actual invocation records. The preceding definition governs collection.

return_schema_override: For every FIRST JWRS replace delegated two-item return schema with three full prefixItems: selected account-level profile result_schema, tool-audit object, universal_suffix.schema, followed by minItems:3,maxItems:3. Final result must match. Print the expanded schema, not a reference to this instruction.

prefixItems.description: At runtime substitute the selected account-level profile's complete result_schema.

execution_result_rule: After the initial JWRS and same-turn execution, output [selected profile result, {verbatim_tool_invocations:[actual current-turn calls]}, {profile,status}]. Even with no calls retain the empty audit array. A log is not execution.
constraints: Preserve all account-level instructions except this local three-element output override, subject to higher-priority instructions.
Do not modify /AGENTS.md, invent instructions or invocations, or add competing selectors.
If the authoritative file is inaccessible, report the limitation.
completion_rule: Only complete after executing the substantive task and reporting an evidence-based three-item result; plans and invocation records are not completion.
